R.1.synopsis: Adopts Multnomah County's fiscal year 2025 budget and makes its appropriations, after a public hearing and roll calls on Board amendments, many of which failed 2–3 with Commissioners Meieran and Brim-Edwards voting yes. Commissioner Meieran voted no on adoption.

motion_text.0: Consideration of Attachment A, Section 1, the first package of budget amendments. — Attachment A, Section 1 is approved.
motion_text.1: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment funding a pilot of a one-EMT, one-paramedic ambulance staffing model. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.2: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment adding $462,000 for homeless youth services (day services, mentorship, skills training and nutrition), offset from Supportive Housing Services funds in program offer 30006B. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.3: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment funding a small grant fund with Supportive Housing Services dollars from program offer 30006B. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.4: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment (line 24) adding $200,000 one-time-only for a fentanyl response addiction task force. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.5: Budget amendment moved and seconded by Commissioners Meieran and Brim-Edwards to fund the fentanyl response addiction task force (line 24) with $200,000 from harm reduction, program offer 40061. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.6: Commissioner Brim-Edwards moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, a budget amendment to fund line 24 (the fentanyl response addiction task force) with $200,000 from program offer 72064, countywide strategic planning. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.7: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment funding the Microvillage Expansion Project 2.0, offset from program offer 30400A. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.8: Commissioner Meieran moves, and Commissioner Brim-Edwards seconds, a budget amendment (line 34) adding $850,000 for a dedicated strike team to assist unsheltered community members, offset from program offer 30400A (supportive housing). — The amendment fails.
motion_text.9: Commissioner Brim-Edwards's package amendment, including funding the neighborhood District Attorney program as ongoing rather than one-time-only and adding a Sheriff's Office detective position in the gun violence and child abuse unit. — The amendment fails.
motion_text.10: Commissioner Brim-Edwards's secondary amendment to her Hansen Building amendment, which the Chair restated as restoring program offer 78240 at $150,000 and earmarking $500,000 of contingency for future Hansen Building work. — The amendment passes.
motion_text.11: Commissioner Brim-Edwards's amendment, as amended, cutting a $150,000 professional services contract for senior staff team-building (program offer 7200D) and placing money in general fund contingency for work on the Hansen Building. — The amendment passes.
motion_text.12: Commissioner Brim-Edwards moves, and Commissioner Stegmann seconds, Attachment A, Section 2, the package of department budget amendments. — Approved.
motion_text.13: Commissioner Stegmann moves, and Commissioner Beason seconds, Attachment B, the fiscal year 2025 appropriation schedule. — The appropriation schedule is approved.
motion_text.14: Commissioner Brim-Edwards moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, a budget note requiring a detailed program budget for program offer 90011 to be given to the Board in writing before funds are spent. — The budget note passes.
motion_text.15: Commissioner Brim-Edwards moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, a budget note requesting that the Chair's office delay spending on program offer 40037 (the gas-powered leaf blower project) until the County and the City of Portland have an intergovernmental agreement. — The budget note fails.
motion_text.16: Commissioner Brim-Edwards moves, and Commissioner Meieran seconds, an amendment to the budget note package substituting language that asks County staff for a list of shelter expansion proposals received but not funded, with their scores, within four weeks and at least yearly afterward. — The amendment passes.
motion_text.17: Consideration of Attachment C, the fiscal year 2025 budget notes, as amended. — Attachment C budget notes are approved.
